title: A CTO reads the call-time example as reward hacking — 'a model gets better at the metric it's optimising for without getting better at what we actually care about'
summary: Ramakrishnan is building Tenax ai with Elyse Myrans and says the book is what he turned to in thinking about the company it should become. He takes the book's customer-service example, where calls get shorter and service gets worse, through Goodhart's law and into his own field. He borrowed the copy from a UK public library.
blockquote: When a measure becomes a target it stops being a good measure. We see a version of this in machine learning when a model gets better at the metric it’s optimising for without getting better at what we actually care about.
